item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - [REQUEST] Music Video Upscales / Restorations (1080p / 4K)
item.description:
Hello everyone!
I'm currently working on expanding my music video archive as part of my personal preservation project, Lew's Media Vault (LMV).

I'm wondering whether anyone here has any high-quality 1080p or 4K upscales/restorations of music videos, particularly older videos that haven't received proper HD remasters.

I'm especially interested in upscales made from good-quality sources, such as DVD, broadcast masters, ProRes files, or other high-quality transfers, rather than simply upscaled YouTube downloads.

I'm not expecting miracles, of course! I understand that older material has its limitations, and I appreciate the amount of time and effort that goes into restoration work.

If anyone has any upscales they're happy to share, or recommendations for restorations worth checking out, I'd be incredibly grateful.

I'm also working on my own restorations and upscales, so it'd be lovely to connect with others who share the same passion for preserving music video history.

Thank you so much in advance!

– LewsMediaVault
item.author: LewsMediaVault
